focus: Angle 3 — SKILL.md against references and assets

findingDetails.title: Leaf-manifest generator skips symlinks, leaving 12 sk-code workflow doctrine files untyped
findingDetails.evidence: Four sk-code surfaces each carry references/workflow-implement.md, workflow-debug.md and workflow-verify.md as symlinks to ../../shared/references/. None of the 12 appears in any leaf-manifest entry, while all 12 resolve on disk. Every unreachable file in the fleet is a symlink (12 of 12; zero non-symlink unreachables). walkLeafFiles applies entry.isFile() after entry.isDirectory(), and Dirent.isFile() is false for a symlink, so the walk neither recurses nor emits. The CI freshness gate regenerates with this same walker, so it byte-compares green over the incomplete set.
findingDetails.impact: The hub documents a per-surface implement-debug-verify doctrine, links it into each surface, and then fails to type it; a reader resolving behaviour through leaf-manifest.json cannot see the doctrine the hub prose says the surface carries.
findingDetails.recommendation: Make the walker resolve symlinks (use fs.statSync or follow the link) or copy the doctrine into each surface instead of linking it. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Enumerated every file under all 17 packets' references/ and assets/ and compared against each mode's manifest rather than sampling; traced the mechanism to the generator walker; checked the symlink targets resolve.

findingDetails.title: Implement-debug-verify doctrine reachable only by prose citation in four surfaces
findingDetails.evidence: SKILL.md:39 says the doctrine lives once in shared/references/workflow-*.md and is symlinked into each surface. SKILL.md:62 defines hub-level inputs as control resources that resolve on disk but never project as leaves, and ROUTER.md:629-637 declares eight SHARED_CONTROL_RESOURCES paths, none of which is a workflow-*.md. So the originals are non-leaves by design, the surface copies are symlinks the walker skips, and the files appear in no manifest. All eight declared control resources do resolve on disk, so the carve-out itself is sound.
findingDetails.impact: The doctrine is reachable by prose citation only, which is precisely the surface the manifest exists to formalise, and the hub either/or against its containment rule is unresolved.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the three workflow doctrine files to SHARED_CONTROL_RESOURCES so their non-leaf status is declared, or type them as leaves. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the hub containment rule, listed and existence-checked all eight declared control resources, confirmed no workflow file appears among them, then checked shared/references for the originals.

findingDetails.title: Two sk-code surfaces sit at 0.1.* against 1.0.0.2 or above with no changelog explanation
findingDetails.evidence: sk-code-mobile-cli=0.1.11.0 and sk-code-obsidian=0.1.0.0 against sk-code-review=1.6.0.0, sk-code-webflow=1.1.0.0, sk-code-opencode=1.0.0.5 and sk-code-quality=1.0.0.2. Both are registered as live packetKind entries. The gap does not track packet size: quality and review have the smallest leaf counts (3 and 10).
findingDetails.impact: A reader cannot tell whether these two surfaces are current or neglected, and the 0.1.* prefix implies pre-1.0 for two live registered modes.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a changelog entry explaining the 0.1.* line, or promote both to the sibling major line. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read all six sk-code mode SKILL.md version fields and the hub changelog entries, then checked whether the low versions tracked packet size, which they do not.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Seventeen mode packets across three hubs, 474 leaf files, a generator-produced manifest, and mode-level version fields compared against sibling surfaces.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Reachability is decided by the manifest generator, so the walker plus the four surfaces that use symlinks are the highest-value targets for the property the angle names second.

searchLedger.invariant: Every file under a packet's references/ or assets/ is reachable as a typed leaf.

searchActions.queryOrPath: all 17 packets' references/ and assets/ against each mode's leaf-manifest leaves
searchActions.result: 12 unreachable files, all symlinks, across four sk-code surfaces; zero everywhere else in the fleet.

searchLedger.rationale: The doctrine the hub says each surface carries is absent from the manifest that types packet resources.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The generator walker emits symlinked files.

searchActions.queryOrPath: read walkLeafFiles and test Dirent.isFile against the symlink entries
searchActions.result: entry.isDirectory() then entry.isFile() means a symlink satisfies neither, so it is neither recursed nor emitted.

searchLedger.rationale: Mechanism-level confirmation of the producer defect behind the surface symptom.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The CI freshness gate would catch an incomplete manifest.

searchActions.queryOrPath: read the gate and confirm it regenerates with the same generator before byte-comparing
searchActions.result: It regenerates with buildManifestBytes from the same module, so it green-lights the set the same walker produced.

searchLedger.rationale: The gap is invisible to the gate that exists to catch manifest drift, which is part of F011's impact.

searchLedger.invariant: Hub-level inputs that never project as leaves are all declared in SHARED_CONTROL_RESOURCES.

searchActions.queryOrPath: parse SHARED_CONTROL_RESOURCES and existence-check every declared path
searchActions.result: Eight declared, all eight resolve on disk, but no workflow-*.md appears among them while three such files exist in shared/references.

searchLedger.rationale: The carve-out is sound for what it lists; the doctrine files are outside its declared scope while also being non-leaf by design.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Mode version fields are comparable across sibling surfaces.

searchActions.queryOrPath: all six sk-code mode SKILL.md version fields plus hub changelog entries
searchActions.result: Two surfaces at 0.1.* against four at 1.0.0.2 or above, with no changelog explanation and no size correlation.

searchLedger.rationale: Advisory provenance gap only; nothing in the artifact set claims these modes are stable.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The symlink skip affects every hub.

searchActions.queryOrPath: symlink census under references/ and assets/ across all three hubs
searchActions.result: system-deep-loop 122 files 0 symlinks; cli-external-orchestration 66 files 0 symlinks; sk-code 286 files 12 symlinks.

searchLedger.rationale: Only sk-code links instead of copying, so the defect is contained to that hub.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Zero symlinks in the other two hubs makes the walker's skip behaviour unreachable there.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A registry projection carries a per-mode version that a packet SKILL.md could disagree with.

searchActions.queryOrPath: registry entry keys across all three hubs for a version field
searchActions.result: No mode-registry entry in any hub carries a per-mode version key, so there is no projection to disagree with.

searchLedger.rationale: Property 3 could only be tested by sibling comparison, which is why F013 is scoped that way.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Absent projection field means no per-mode version-parity contract exists to violate.
